s.how: Set out strips of 100g beef jerky, 250g sharp cheddar cut into chunks, crackers and a big bowl of 200g salted peanuts on the ranch house porch.

s.note: the guys' life back in the city
s.how: Split and toast 8 mini bagels. Spread with 150g cream cheese and top with 150g smoked salmon, capers, thin red onion and dill. A little taste of home for the city boys.

m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced beef chuck. Add 4 soaked and blitzed dried chillies, 2 tsp cumin, 3 garlic cloves, a tin of tomatoes and a tin of kidney beans. Braise 3 hours. Serve with a skillet of cornbread.

w.note: sitting under the stars with the herd
w.how: Toast 16 big marshmallows on sticks over the fire until blistered. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 digestive biscuits, 100g chocolate and 32 biscuits in all, and press so it melts.

d.how: Bring 1.2L water to the boil in a pot and stir in 80g coarse ground coffee. Boil 4 minutes, then splash in a little cold water to settle the grounds. Pour black into tin mugs, carefully.
